title: DECLARE THIS 30 MINUTES VIOLENT PRAYER EVERY MORNING THIS NEW WEEK - APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
text: Beloved people of God, hear me as I declare unto you by the spirit of the living God. Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised, and his greatness is unsearchable. Psalm 145:3. This is not just another week. It is the womb of possibilities, a new chapter that heaven has opened unto us. And the Lord sent me to announce this week will not swallow you. This week will not waste you. This week will not rob you of your portion. I stand under the anointing of the Holy Ghost and I decree the covenanteping God will prove himself faithful in your life in the name of Jesus. Psalm 145 is a psalm of exaltation, a psalm of remembrance. Verse 14 says, "The Lord upholdeth all that fall and raiseth up all those that be bowed down." Someone listening to me right now has been bowed down with burdens, weighed down with anxiety, pressed under the yoke of affliction, but hear the word of the Lord. This week, the hand of God will lift you up. I decree by the spirit, every heavy load on your shoulders is lifted right now. every spirit of depression, every yoke of heaviness, every chain of fear break in the name of Jesus. And the Bible says in Psalm 145:1 19, he will fulfill the desire of them that fear him. He also will hear their cry and will save them. I prophesy over you this week. Your cries have reached heaven. The Lord will fulfill your desires. That financial breakthrough you have prayed about, receive it. That visa approval you have trusted God for, let it be released now. That healing you have asked the Lord for, be made whole this week in the mighty name of Jesus. I decree and declare this week your table shall not be empty. The Lord shall satisfy you with good things. No power of darkness will abort the prophecy of God over your life. Every arrow fired against your destiny, I return. Remembrance, divine visibility, divine promotion. May kings not sleep until they favor you. May helpers arise for you this week. Lift your hands wherever you are and receive this prayer. I decree over your destiny. Let every course of stagnation be broken. I decree advancement. I decree speed. I decree enlargement. May your spiritual life catch fire. May your prayer altar burn Aresh. Let there be hunger for the word of God. Let your intimacy with the Holy Spirit deepen this week. The Lord shall restore wasted years, wasted opportunities, wasted seasons. You will not end this week in shame. You will not end this week in defeat. You will not end this week in tears. Father, we exalt you. We declare like the psalmist in Psalm 145:1-2. I will extol thee my God, O king, and I will bless thy name forever and ever. Every day will I bless thee and I will praise thy name forever and ever. Lord, as we enter this week, we choose to praise you in advance. We lift our hearts, our voices, our hands, and we enthrone you. Let the atmosphere of our homes be saturated with your glory. Let your angels go before us. Let your spirit overshadow us. And let this week answer to the power of the covenant. Beloved, I seal these declarations with the blood of Jesus. They will not be reversed. They will not be hindered. They will not be aborted. Step into this new week with boldness, with joy, with confidence, knowing that the God of Psalm 145 is your defense, your provider, your restorer, your lifter. And now I decree this week will end in your testimony in Jesus mighty name. Amen. And amen. Hear me dearly beloved. The spirit of God is saying clearly, "This week shall not be ordinary for you. For it is written in Psalm 145 to 16, the eyes of all wait upon thee, and thou givest them their meat in due season. Thou openest and hear me as I declare, every satanic voice speaking against your progress is silenced in the name of Jesus. Every handwriting of ordinances contrary to your destiny is blotted out by the blood. Every altar of delay catch fire now. Every power of limitation break now. I decree supernatural acceleration. You will cover in days what others take years to achieve. You will overtake. You will recover. You will advance. I speak into your relationships. peace, understanding, divine connection. Every covenant of bitterness, break every arrangement of divorce, scatter every arrow against your marriage, return to sender. I decree healing in your whole. May the God of Psalm 145:14 raise up those bowed down in your family. Let there be joy where there has been sorrow. Let there be laughter where there has been tears. Let there be testimonies where there has been disappointments. Thus sayeth the spirit of God. Someone under the sound of my voice is about to enter into a contract that will shift their financial destiny. Another is about to receive a call that will redefine their story. The Lord says, "Fear not, for I go before you to prepare the way. This week I decree strange favor upon your name. May your name be spoken of in the palace. May your name be remembered in the place of honor. No demon will cover your star. No witchcraft will bury your glory. No enchantment will prosper against you. Beloved, lift your voice in faith where you are and declare, I receive my portion this week. I walk in favor. I walk in power. I walk in breakthrough. I walk in victory. Yes. Decree it boldly. For the word says in Job 22:28, "Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, and the light shall shine upon thy ways." As you decree, let light shine upon your path. As you prophesy, let the heavens open. Ask beloved, let your heart be open, for the spirit of the Lord is still moving. Hear me. Psalm 145:11 declares, "They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom and talk of thy power." This week, your life shall become a testimony of God's glory. I prophesy in the name of Jesus. Your story will speak of his power. Your testimony will reveal his kingdom. This week, men will see your life and glorify God. Those who mocked you will return to honor you. Those who doubted you will testify with you. The evidence of God's power shall be undeniable in your life. I decree and declare that the kingdom of God will find expression in your business, in your career, in your academics, in your ministry, and in your household. No demonic kingdom will rise against you and prevail. For it is written, thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations. Psalm 145:13. Every other throne, every other dominion, every other altar that seeks to challenge the dominion of Christ over your life, collapse now in the name of Jesus. Someone under the sound of my voice has been battling delay after delay. Delay in marriage, delay in promotion, delay in contracts, delay in conception. But I prophesy as a servant of the Lord, your delay is over this week. The hand of the Lord comes upon you and he hastens your steps. I decrease supernatural speed. What has been locked for years, let it be unlocked this week. That letter of acceptance, that promotion list, that visa approval, that financial door be opened now. Beloved, I decree divine health over you. For the word says in Psalm 145:8, "The Lord is gracious and full of compassion, slow to anger and of great mercy." That mercy will heal you. That mercy will restore your bones, your blood, your organs, your thus sayeth the spirit of God. Someone has been crying, "Lord, will you ever settle me?" The Lord says, "This week I will settle you." That longstanding case in court be settled. That debt hanging over you be cancelled. That joblessness that has mocked you be overturned. That marital crisis that has lingered be resolved. The God of Psalm 145 will show his greatness in your case. Lift up your hands and declare with me, I am victorious this week. I walk in divine provision this week. I walk in open doors this week. I walk in health this week. I walk in favor this week. No weapon fashioned against me shall prosper this week. Every tongue rising against me is condemned this week. I am more than a conqueror this week. Beloved, worship him with me. Father, we extol your name. We declare with David that one generation shall praise thy works to another and shall declare thy mighty acts. Verse four, we are that generation. And this week our lives will declare your mighty acts. Receive glory. Receive honor. Receive worship. For yours is the kingdom, the power, and the glory forever and ever. And now in the mighty name of Jesus, I seal these decrees. They are irreversible. They are unshakable. They are unmovable. Go forth into this week with joy, with boldness, and with expectation. For surely you will return with a testimony. Amen. And amen. Hear me. By the spirit of the living God. The atmosphere is charged and the hand of the Lord is mighty in this place. For it is written in Psalm 145 verse 20, "The Lord preserveth all them that love him, but all the wicked will he destroy. This week preservation shall be your portion. I decree and declare no arrow of destruction will locate you. No weapon formed against you shall prosper. No scheme of the wicked shall I speak over your weak. No misfortune. No tragedy. No sudden calamity. The angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear him and deliverth them. I decree angelic encampments around your dwelling place. I release waring angels to fight on your behalf. I command ministering angels to bring resources into your hands. Angels of healing attend to your body. Angels of favor attend to your career. Angels of warfare scatter the plots of darkness against your destiny. Hear me. The Lord says to someone, "I have seen your tears in the secret place and I have heard your cry. This week I arise as your defender. Beloved, I prophesy where men said there is no way, God himself will make a way. Where doors have been shut repeatedly, let the eternal doors open. I decree the voice of the accuser against you is silenced, the blood of Jesus speaks better things than the blood of Abel. Let the blood speak victory for you this week. Let the blood speak settlement for you. Let the blood speak deliverance for you this week. Your enemies shall stumble and fall. For it is written in Psalm 27:E2, "When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell." I decree those who gather against you shall scatter by fire. Those who rise against you shall fall for your sake. Those who stretch their hands against you shall wither in shame. The Lord himself shall fight for you and you shall hold your peace. Lift your voice and decree, I am preserved by the hand of God. I am defended by the blood of Jesus. I am lifted above reproach. My household is shielded. My destiny is untouchable. Every curse is broken. Every altar is shattered. Every chain is loosed. Beloved, let us lift a cry of worship. Lord, we magnify you for your kingdom is everlasting. We exalt. Child of God, hear me as I speak by the authority of heaven. This week is not permitted to swallow your destiny. For the word of God declares in Psalm 145:E1 19, he will fulfill the desire of them that fear him. He also will hear their cry and will save them. Your desires shall not be aborted. Your cries shall not be ignored. Your salvation shall not be delayed. Every expectation in righteousness that you have lifted before the Lord, receive manifestation in the name of Jesus. This is the week where causes are broken. Every evil handwriting of ordinances written against you is blotted out by the blood of Jesus. Colossians 2:14. Every ancestral altar speaking limitation, stagnation, delay, and failure into your destiny. I command fire upon those altars. Every padlock that has sealed your breakthrough, every chain that has tied dying down your progress, every yoke that has resisted your lifting, I break them now in the name of Jesus. Let there be a release. Let there be a breaking forth. Let there be an open door. I prophesy over your finances this week. Money will answer to you. Favor will locate you. opportunities will embrace you. Let debts be cancelled. Let closed doors be opened. Let forgotten contracts be remembered. May the Lord give you witty ideas, creative wisdom, and supernatural connections that will change your financial story. You will not beg this week. You will not lack this week. Your storehouse will not be empty this week. I decree upon your family peace, health, and divine protection. Every arrow of untimely death is canled. Every spirit of infirmity, I cast you out. Every demonic manipulation over children be broken. Let the joy of the Lord fill your home. May this week be marked by laughter, testimonies, and restoration in your household. And I stand as a prophet of God to decree restoration. Joel 2:20. Lift your hands wherever you are and make this decree with faith. I decree that my destiny is untouchable. I decree that my portion cannot be diverted. I decree that my star cannot be deemed. I decree that my health cannot be destroyed. I decree that my family cannot be scattered. I decree that my finances cannot be swallowed. I decree that this week must favor me. I decree that every satanic agenda is overturned. I decree that I am more than a conqueror. Father, we return glory to you for you alone do great wonders. You are the God who raises the poor out of the dust and sets him among princes. You are the God who makes a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert. Lord, show forth your greatness in the lives of your people this week. Now I seal these prayers by the blood of Jesus. No power will reverse them. By the authority of scripture, no demon will contest them. By the mercy of God, no altar will resist them. This week, you will shout for joy. This week your enemies will be confounded. This week your light will shine brighter and brighter in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. It is done. Amen and amen. I stand in the authority of the word. And I declare this is the week when the sword of the Lord will contend with those who contend with you. For it is written in Isaiah 49:25, "I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children." And Psalm 145:20 reminds us, the Lord preserved all them that love him, but all the wicked will he destroy. care for every stubborn pursuer, every unrepentant adversary, every satanic priesthood raising sacrifices against your life, let the judgment of God answer them swiftly in the name of Jesus, I decree this week, every network of witchcraft monitoring your star, collapse by fire. every mirror where your image. I prophesy upon your gates and doors. Lift up your heads, oh ye gates, and be ye lift up ye everlasting doors. And the king of glory shall come in this week. No ancient gate will stop your rising. No everlasting door will block your lifting. The glory of the Lord shall break through every resistance. Hear me beloved. Every evil arrow shot against you in the day or at night, I return it back to send us sevenfold. Arrows of sickness, go back. Arrows of sudden death, go back. Arrows of poverty, go back. Arrows of confusion, go back. Arrows of marital delay, go back. For the Bible says in Psalm 91:5, "Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, nor for the arrow that flieth by day. I decree you are shielded. You are defended. You are covered. Thus sayeth the spirit of God." There is someone hearing me right now. They have tied your name in an evil covenant. But I announce to you by the blood of the lamb that covenant is broken. Every agreement made on your behalf in the realm of darkness, I cancel it now. Every evil handwriting, I erase it now. Every verdict of death, I reverse it now. You shall not die, but live and declare the works of the Lord. Lift your voice and decree with me. I decree this week, I am a weapon in the hand of God. No altar will silence me. No power will cage me. No cause will follow me. No spell will prosper against me. No enchantment will prevail. I walk in dominion. I walk in victory. I walk in authority. The Lord preserves me. My family, my destiny. The wicked are destroyed. I am lifted above shame. I am crowned with glory. Father, we thank you. We bless your name because you are a righteous judge. You fight for us. You defend us. You establish us. We exalt you. I prophesy upon your gates and doors. Lift up your heads, oh ye gates, and be ye lift up ye everlasting doors, and the King of glory shall come in. This week, no ancient gate will stop your rising. No everlasting door will block your lifting. The glory of the Lord shall break through every resistance. Hear me, beloved. Every evil arrow shot against you in the day or at night. I return it back to send us sevenfold. Arrows of sickness, go back. Arrows of sudden death, go back. Arrows of poverty, go back. Arrows of confusion, go back. Arrows of marital delay, go back. For the Bible says in Psalm 91:5, "Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, nor for the arrow that flieth by day. I decree you are shielded. You are defended. You are covered. Thus saith the spirit of God." There is someone hearing me right now. They have tied your name in an evil covenant. But I announce to you by the blood of the lamb, that covenant is broken. Every agreement made on your behalf in the realm of darkness, I cancel it now. Every evil and writing, I erase it now. Every verdict of death, I reverse it now. You shall not die, but live and declare the works of the Lord. Lift your voice and decree with me. I decree this week I am a weapon in the hand of God. No altar will silence me. No power will cage me. No cause will follow me. No spell will prosper against me. No enchantment will prevail. I walk in dominion. I walk in victory. I walk in authority. The Lord preserves me. My family, my destiny, the wicked are destroyed. I am lifted above shame. I am crowned with glory. Father, we thank you. We bless your name because you are a righteous judge. You fight for us. You defend us. You establish us. We exalt you. We honor you. For you are the God who restores. You are the God who lifts men from the donghill and sex them among princes. You are the God who changes stories in one day. Lord, do for your people what no man can do. Let there be undeniable evidence that you are with them. And now I seal part seven with the power of the Holy Ghost. I decree and declare you will not end this week in shame. You will not end this week in lack. You will not end this week in sickness. You will not end this week in defeat. By the time this week is over, your testimony shall be loud. Your miracle shall be visible. Your lifting shall be undeniable. In the mighty name of Jesus Christ, so shall it be. Amen. And amen.
